Synopsis:
    Heavy outflows from U.S. equity funds ($32.27B, nine-month high) driven by Iran war-induced oil price surge (WTI hitting $104.46/bbl). Elevated inflation data (PPI/CPI) is fueling expectations the Fed may hike rates imminently. Large-cap funds bore the brunt (-$40.44B record outflows). Bond funds continued their 21-consecutive-week inflow streak ($6.56B), with rotation into short-duration investment-grade and government paper. Money market funds saw $10.41B in outflows after a large prior-week inflow.
